name: scriptura-frontend
description: Scriptura — Divinetalk internal AI blog automation tool (web app)
//devDependencies: The three @testing-library packages must all resolve ONE copy of
@testing-library/dom. react@14 depends on dom ^9 while user-event@14 resolves
dom ^10, which installs both — a hoisted v10 and a nested v9. RTL then
configures the nested copy while user-event imports the hoisted one, so
interactions ran against unconfigured wrappers: ~35 spurious 'not wrapped in
act' warnings, and state updates not flushed when an interaction resolved.
react@16 peers on dom ^10, so pinning react ^16 + dom ^10 aligns all three.
Verify after any bump with: npm ls @testing-library/dom (expect one version).
